Yone|top.identity: Crit-based fighter dealing mixed damage (physical and magic). Every second attack deals magic damage (passive). Mortal Steel (Q) strikes in a line and, on the third cast, dashes and knocks up enemies hit; Spirit Cleave (W) strikes in a cone and gives a shield; Soul Unbound (E) separates his soul from his body and, at the end, repeats part of the damage dealt; Fate Sealed (R) dashes through a line and pulls enemies hit.
Yone|top.playstyle: Short trades and all-ins with E. Yone is strong at every stage and excels in messy fights. He relies heavily on managing E: using it well means going in, hitting and snapping back to his body safely.
Yone|top.early_game: Stack Q on minions to have Q3 ready, then trade with Q + W. W's shield absorbs part of the counterattack. Keep E for all-ins: without it, you're an easy target.
Yone|top.level_1: Mortal Steel (Q) first. Stack Q on minions and poke your opponent when they come to last hit.
Yone|top.level_2: Spirit Cleave (W). A cone with a shield: Q → W is your basic short trade.
Yone|top.level_3: Soul Unbound (E). All-in: E → Q3 (knock-up) → W → attacks, then snap back to your body. The snap back repeats part of the damage dealt during E.
Yone|top.level_6: Fate Sealed: a line that knocks enemies toward you. Combo: E → R → Q3 → W. In teamfights, aim for several targets.
power_spikes: Level 6: ultimate for engages and kills.
First completed item: heavy crit damage.
Two items: one of the best teamfight fighters.
Yone|top.lane_plan: Play a neutral wave, stack Q on minions and trade briefly with Q + W. Keep E for all-ins. Take plates when you're winning. Recall when your wave crashes. The lane's walls let you dash through with Q3.
Yone|top.trading: Short trade: Q → W → back off. Long trade: E → Q3 → W → attacks → snap back to your body. Engage when your Q3 is ready; give up on it against champions who stun you (Irelia, Kennen) or when your E is on cooldown.
threats: Irelia and champions who beat you in melee range.
Warwick and champions who follow you after E.
mistakes: Using E when you can't snap back to safety.
Engaging without your ultimate or Q3.

matchup_notes.Jax: His Counter Strike dodges your attacks: use Q and W during his dodge.
matchup_notes.Aatrox: Dodge his sweet spots with E and Q3.
matchup_notes.Irelia: She beats you in melee range: trade briefly and keep E for her all-ins.
matchup_notes.Malphite: His armor bothers you: farm and play for teamfights.

Yone|top.mid_game: Skirmishes and split pushing. Yone excels in messy river fights.
Yone|top.late_game: Go in after the enemy CC, ultimate on several targets, then E to snap back to safety.
Yone|top.ahead: Force duels, dive with your jungler and take towers.
Yone|top.behind: Farm and play teamfights after the enemy CC.
Yone|top.win_condition: To win this game, you want to dominate your lane through short trades and clean up teamfights with your ultimate.
Yone|top.final_tip: Before using E, look at where your body is: that's where you'll snap back to.
